hypothesis: Repeated reference captures can erase task-relative loss from controller error. A drift-cycle hypothesis needs measured recurrence, a compatible clipping regime, and positive drift; accumulated loss alone is insufficient.

rows.limitations: Only 3 closed capture-to-capture cycles. Export omits full attitude/omega, GRU, actuator and clock caches. No exact recurrence or invariant region is established.
